The deprecated `db` and `passwd` keyword arguments in the MySQL backend have been updated in favor of `database` and `password`:

- Updated [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-w33r6ov3/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L230) in [base.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-w33r6ov3/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py) to set `kwargs['database']` and `kwargs['password']` instead of `kwargs['db']` and `kwargs['passwd']`.
- Updated [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-w33r6ov3/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L60) in [client.py](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-w33r6ov3/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py) to support the `'database'` key in `OPTIONS` (falling back to `'db'` and `NAME`).
